Before every single voyage, no matter how small... Tomas never forgot to wrap something sacred around his wrist. A set of wooden rosary beads handed down from his mother. I feel its peaceful presence nearby.

He was a quiet man of deep faith. When the sky turned dark, he would clutch his wooden rosary and pray not for a heavy net, but that every father out at sea would return safely to their children. Look nearby—the rosary shines.
My mother always said a faithful husband leaves a legacy of prayer. Before he pushed his boat into the surge, he knelt briefly on the wet sand with his rosary. Search near the path.
I remember the smooth wooden beads he held every night at angelus. Even when we had little to eat, he thanked God for another day together. A fragment of his sacred rosary lies close by.
He held that rosary in his hand when he pushed off into the dark storm... praying for our village until his very last breath. You can find his rosary glowing right over there.
